title: terrain.cave_in_triggered
description: M14E cave-in event emitted when the per-tick cave-in roll fires on a chunk whose `structural_integrity_field` dropped below the cave-in threshold. Drives the `cave_in_thunder` audio cue, the falling-debris particle cone, and the M14 `fall_impulse_chain` damage path on actors underneath.

chunk_id.description: Chunk coordinate as [cx, cy] in chunk-space.

bbox.description: Inclusive pixel-space AABB of the collapsing ceiling region.

falling_debris_count.description: Number of falling-debris pixels spawned. min(span_px × ceiling_thickness, 200).

unsupported_span_px.description: Unsupported tunnel span (pixels) that drove the cave-in roll.

vibration_modifier.description: Vibration modifier the roll consumed (1.0 baseline; 2.0 plasma cutter).

chance_per_tick.description: Per-tick cave-in probability the roll consumed.

cascade_primary.description: True when this cave-in is the primary trigger; false when secondary (cascaded from a neighbor chunk).

ceiling_thickness_px.description: Ceiling thickness (pixels) used in the falling_debris_count formula.
